newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold closes easier in busy trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold closes easier in busy trade.

text.p: The Istanbul gold exchange attracted brisk trading on Thursday with volume leaping to 2,030 kg from Wednesday's 881 kg on seasonal physical demand and arbitrage trade by banks, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly lower at $328.00 an ounce and 1,683,000 lira per gram, compared with $328.50 and 1,687,500 lira on Wednesday.
The losses reflected weaker prices on European markets.
"There is strong seasonal physical demand right now, but about half the day's trade was due to arbitrage by the banks," one dealer said.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,555 kg -- took place in the morning session, with 55.9 percent conducted in dollar terms.
